_notes: Register: the Student web app and the student-facing native strings use the warm singular 'tu' (Romanian consumer apps: Vinted, Glovo, ING Home'Bank); every existing 'dumneavoastră' student string was converted so one register runs through. Staff-facing strings (mobile:agency.*, mobile:university.*, mobile:v3.agency/reviews/tasks/deadlines/uni/settings.*, mobile:v4.uni/reviews.*, mobile:v29.mfa.*) use the formal plural ('dumneavoastră', 'Solicitați', 'Validați') — concise, operational.

One term per concept: plan = plan (all 'pachet' removed; 'pachet' sounded like a tourism package and collided with marketing copy); consultation = consultație (all 'sesiune de consultanță' removed); application = candidatură / a depune; document review = verificare, while 'verify' (the official act of marking a document verified) = a valida / validat, so the two reads are never confused; university review of an application = evaluare; essay = eseu (was 'texte'); personal statement = scrisoare de intenție (one key said 'scrisoare de motivație'); study plan = plan de studiu; dormitory = cămin, housing = cazare; arrival and settling-in help = ajutor la sosire și instalare; additional service = serviciu suplimentar; standard admission letter = scrisoare standard de admitere; apostille = apostilă; consular legalization = supralegalizare consulară; certified translation = traducere autorizată; transcript = foaie matricolă.

'Matches' (automatic eligibility results) is rendered as 'programele potrivite (pentru tine)' / 'universitățile potrivite'; the literal 'potriviri' reads as a word puzzle in Romanian. Short badge labels keep 'Potrivire posibilă / puternică'. 'University recommendation' (the team's proposal) stays 'recomandare de universități' so the two concepts never merge.

Romanian plurals: added `_few` (2–19 and numbers ending 02–19) for every counted noun; `_other` (20+) carries the mandatory 'de'. Keys whose count sits beside a noun inside a sentence with no plural forms (COMPARE_OFFERS, PROFILE_UNLOCK.*, university.documentsCount) were reshaped to put the number in parentheses or after a colon so 'de' is not needed. mobile:v29.plan.supportDays was given the same colon shape; if the day count is always ≥20 the owner may prefer '{{count}} de zile'.

Gender: Romanian past participles agree with the reader ('admis/admisă'); status lines were worded gender-neutrally ('Ai primit admiterea', 'Înmatricularea este gata', 'Încă nu îndeplinești cerințele') instead of assuming masculine.

Where the current Romanian said 'consilierul tău' but the English says 'the Hangyul team' (v3.home.nextBody.ESSAY_WRITE, v4.application.reviewLate/writeOnWeb, v4.home.item.WRITE_ESSAY.text) the team wording was restored; where it said 'Hangyul Univ' but the English says 'Hangyul team', aligned to the English. mobile:signup CROSS_BORDER summary had extra claims (data transferred, retention period) not in the English and was aligned to the web version. PRIVACY summary said 'hash-ul parolei'; aligned to 'parolă (stocată criptat)' as in the English.

App names mobile:app.* (Hangyul Univ / Hangyul Agency / Hangyul University) are official product names and stay in English, as do GKS, TOPIK, IELTS, TOEFL iBT, visa codes and the example institution name in institutionPh.

Promises: no outcome was added, dropped or softened; 'Hangyul nu încasează niciodată taxa de școlarizare', 'Hangyul nu scrie și nu inventează conținut', visa/admission lines all say what the team does (pregătim, urmărim, verificăm).
